title: Rabbi Chizkiyah bar Yirmeyah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim 92, and Hyman suggests that the reading is “Rabbi Chizkiyah in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah.” Likewise in Kiddushin 1:7: “Rabbi Chizkiyah bar Yirmeyah: if you can trace a tradition back to Moses,” etc.; Hyman proposes reading “in the name of Rabbi Yirmeyah,” as in Shabbat 1:1, folio 3b.

notes.text: The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7 gives Chizkiyah bar Yirmeyah and Chiyya in the name of Yochanan before the saying about tracing a tradition back to Moses.
